init.title: Kia Access options
init.description: By default every update reads Kia's server-side cache, which is gentle on the car's 12V battery. Turn on 'Poll the car directly' only if you need up-to-the-minute data — it wakes the vehicle on every poll and can flatten the 12V battery if the car is parked for long periods.

data.poll_car_directly: Poll the car directly (wakes the vehicle — drains the 12V battery)
data.force_refresh_timeout: Live wake-up wait (seconds) — only used when polling directly
data.price_per_kwh: Price per kWh (your all-in marginal rate, 0 = no cost tracking)
data.range_factor: Range reach factor (haircut on the car's range estimate)
data.range_reserve_pct: Range reach reserve % (arrive with this much charge left)

data_description.poll_car_directly: Off (recommended): data comes from Kia's servers — refreshed whenever the car itself checks in (driving, charging, app use). On: each poll wakes the car for a live reading.
data_description.force_refresh_timeout: How long to wait for the car to answer before falling back to the cached copy for that poll.
